selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of fever, erythema, and elevated inflammatory markers (C-reactive protein and serum ferritin) are consistent with Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome, which is further supported by the temporal relationship with the vaccine administration.

rejected.label: Vaccine-induced immune-mediated thrombocytopenia

rejected.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
rejected.why: The absence of schistocytes on blood smear and the presence of other inflammatory and vascular findings make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Vasculitis

rejected.label: Thrombosis
rejected.why: Although the patient has thrombotic events, they are likely secondary to the underlying inflammatory syndrome rather than a primary thrombotic disorder.
